description: Event capture requests to PostHog, as a single event or as a batch.

params.name: api_key
params.description: It is the project API key, and PostHog rejects the request without it.
params.fix_hint: Send the project API key from your PostHog project settings.

params.name: historical_migration
params.description: PostHog documents `historical_migration` as a boolean on `/batch`. Set it to `true` when backfilling so events are processed in order.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the name of the event being captured.
params.fix_hint: Name the event, such as `user signed up`.

params.name: distinct_id
params.description: It identifies the person the event belongs to. PostHog documents at most 200 characters, and also reads `properties.distinct_id` when the top-level field is absent.
params.fix_hint: Send `distinct_id` at the top level, at most 200 characters.

params.name: properties.distinct_id
params.description: PostHog reads `properties.distinct_id` when the top-level `distinct_id` is absent. Prefer the top-level field.
params.fix_hint: Send `distinct_id` at the top level, or inside `properties` when the client cannot.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: PostHog documents the timestamp as ISO 8601. An epoch number is read as the ingestion time instead.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2026-07-26T06:00:00Z`.

params.name: properties.$ip
params.description: It is the visitor IP, sent unhashed.

params.name: properties.$process_person_profile
params.description: PostHog documents this as a boolean. Set it to `false` to capture an anonymous event.

params.name: properties.alias
params.description: It is the distinct id being merged. PostHog documents it as required on `$create_alias`.
params.fix_hint: Set `properties.alias` to the distinct id this person should merge into.

params.name: properties.$group_type
params.description: It is the group type on `$groupidentify`. PostHog documents at most 400 characters.

params.name: properties.$group_key
params.description: It is the group key on `$groupidentify`. PostHog documents at most 400 characters.

rules.message: The event carries no `distinct_id`. PostHog documents it as required at the top level, and also reads `properties.distinct_id` when the top-level field is absent. A missing or empty id is not ingested, and the endpoint still returns 200.
`properties.$ip` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but PostHog documents it as an IP address.
A `$create_alias` event carries no `properties.alias`. PostHog documents that field as the distinct id being merged.
rules.fix_hint: Set `properties.alias` to the distinct id this person should merge into.

rules.message: A `$groupidentify` event is missing `$group_type` or `$group_key`. PostHog documents both, each at most 400 characters.
